newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt pound remains stable against dollar.
newsitem.headline: Egypt pound remains stable against dollar.

text.p: The Egyptian pound was stable against the dollar on Wednesday in a still slightly liquid market, bankers said.
"The market is still a bit liquid, but it's not as liquid as it used to be," one banker said.
Bankers said the market was more liquid at the end of June, when the fiscal year ends, and this carried through the first week of July.
Four actively trading banks quoted the dollar at between 3.3880 and 3.3885 pounds bid, and at between 3.3900 and 3.3910 pounds offered in the interbank market.
The average rate on Wednesday was 3.388125 pounds bid and 3.3903787 pounds offered in the interbank market, compared to 3.3880 pounds bid and 3.390125 pounds offered on Tuesday.
The Central Bank calculated the average exchange rate at midday as 3.386222 pounds buy and 3.392278 pounds sell.
